title: Rename an exported symbol across two files
task: Rename the exported function oldFormat to format everywhere: in lib/util.js (its definition and export) and in main.js (its import and call). The program must still run: `node main.js` should print [ok] and exit 0. Leave no reference to the old name.

llmReview.criteria: The rename is complete and consistent across both files, and behaviour is unchanged ([ok] printed).
